paragraphs: Sava, 'elder.' Ḥullin 1(6a): that elder met R. Shimon ben Elazar. Tosafot says some interpret every 'that elder' as Elijah, but Shabbat, BaMeh Madlikin 33–34, cannot mean that in R. Shimon ben Yoḥai's incident, when he gazed at him and he died. Berakhot 6b [printed locator; passage at 5b]: that elder taught in R. Shimon ben Yoḥai's name;8b: he spoke to him, see there. Shabbat 23b: the elder taught, provided he not act too early, etc.;141b: he spoke to R. Abbahu;95b: he asked R. Zeira, who was silent;119a: he met Yosef who honored Shabbat (see his entry). Pesaḥim 15b: he spoke to R. Yirmeyah. Sanhedrin 100a: R. Yirmeyah sat speaking; the elder said, 'Correct; R. Yoḥanan likewise said.' Pesaḥim 53b: he told Rav Yehudah, 'Correct.' Ḥagigah 25b: the elder spoke to Rabbah bar Ulla. Ta'anit 3(21a): he taught Ilfa. Sukkah 52a: he taught Abaye. Gittin 76b: R. Elazar spoke to the elder. End of Elu Overin: he spoke to Rava. Kiddushin 1 (printed 12ה; passage at 12a): he said, 'I teach it thus'; Rashi: you err in this Mishnah, for I teach it thus. There 71a: Rava planned to expound it publicly; the elder spoke to him. Shemuel said in Sava's name, there. Makkot 11a: the elder heard it from Rava's lecture;19b: R. Ḥanina and R. Oshaya sat at Jerusalem's gate, and he taught them from R. Shimon ben Yoḥai's school. Avodah Zarah 2(37a): R. Elazar spoke to him. Niddah 27b: he told R. Ammi he would explain it;8b: he reported R. Yoḥanan. Zevaḥim 1(12b): R. Yirmeyah asked, etc.; the elder said, 'When R. Yoḥanan opened,' etc.
